test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On : 7 June 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank number 1.
solution:
The correct answer is '**during**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **most appropriate** word to fill in the blank is '**during**'.
 
• The word '**during**' means '**throughout the course or duration of (a period of time)**'.
 
• Hence, the correct answer is '**during**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Let's look at the other options.
 
 
• **By**- *identifying the agent performing an action.*
 
• **At**- *expressing location or arrival in a particular place or position.*
 
• **Through**- *moving in one side and out of the other side of (an opening, channel, or location).*
